statement: In the xpadneo HOGP output branch, a host-side HID SET_REPORT request is used for rumble; Linux UHID documentation requires a corresponding SET_REPORT_REPLY for synchronous host requests. An emulated Bluetooth-bus UHID device needs to implement that reply and error path if this branch is exercised. Neither host-side completion nor physical hardware response was tested in this research.

applicability.revision: standard Series model 1914, comparisons explicitly scoped to other models
applicability.firmware: not physically measured; source version is pinned
applicability.scope: device.c:14-36; core.c:173-194; existing source uhid (UHID_SET_REPORT and UHID_SET_REPORT_REPLY). This is host API behavior, not radio pairing.
